summary: Frontend-only testing of Mediq landing page completed. All 17 requested feature areas pass: sticky nav with logo, hero CTAs, trust marquee, features bento grid, 4 how-it-works steps, ADHD methods cards, video chunks playlist (5 items) + play button, flashcard flip rotation, MCQ correct/wrong accent state, progress preview, 3 testimonials, pricing monthly/yearly toggle (price changes $19 -> $12), 6-item FAQ accordion expand/collapse, final CTA, footer with 4 social links, mobile menu toggle with 5 nav links at 390px width, theme toggle switches html.dark class, dark mode persists after reload (next-themes), and no white-background sections leak through in dark mode (body bg rgb(6,9,20), all <section> tags pass white-bg audit). No console errors or page errors detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Optional enhancement: individual cards inside Features, AdhdMethods, ProgressPreview and Subject mastery bars don't expose per-item data-testid (e.g. feature-0..n, adhd-pillar-0..3, progress-stat-0..n, subject-mastery-0..n). Adding them would make future automated regression of card counts more robust. Not a defect since the review request only mandated section-level testids which are all present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static landing page at https://study-smart-48.preview.emergentagent.com/. All required data-testids verified: primary-nav, mediq-logo, theme-toggle (html.dark toggling, persists via next-themes localStorage), hero-cta-primary/secondary, step-1..4, video-play-mock, playlist-item-0..4, flashcard-flip (rotates via inner transform), mcq-option-a (wrong/destructive border) and mcq-option-c (correct/accent border), testimonial-0..2, billing-monthly/yearly (Pro $19 monthly -> $12 yearly, save 37%), pricing-free/pro/premium-cta, faq-trigger-0..5 (data-state closed<->open), final-cta-primary, social-0..3, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-nav-features/method/pricing/faq/cta. Dark mode body bg rgb(6,9,20); zero <section> with white background in dark mode. No console or page errors.
